name: Review
description: Reviews an implementation branch and publishes a verdict. Pairs with the Develop template as the downstream gate in a board-driven workflow.

workflows.name: Review
workflows.description: Polling on status=Review. Code Reviewer evaluates the branch, Publish submits the review verdict and moves the ticket.

nodes.name: Publish
nodes.instructionsAppend: Read the upstream Code Reviewer's verdict in `.conduit/`. Submit a review on the pull/merge request via the connected MCP server: approve if the verdict recommends approval, or request changes with inline comments if changes are needed. After submitting the review, move the ticket: on approval move to the ready-to-merge column or label ("ReadyToMerge" by default); on changes requested move back to the development column or label ("Dev" by default).
